bio.introText: Results-oriented full‑stack developer experienced in production-ready projects with strong problem-solving and fast adaptation skills. I build web applications with React, Laravel and Spring Boot focusing on clean, maintainable code, sustainable architectures, and test automation. I care about clear cross-team technical communication, solid data modeling, and high test coverage across layers.

content: Full‑stack developer experienced in production‑grade projects with React, Laravel and Spring Boot.
Focused on clean, maintainable code, comprehensive test automation, and modern software architectures (OOP, SOLID, layered, component‑based).
